## Household and background

Sasha Lindgren (born May 30, 1972) is single with no dependents and lives at 1502 Windmere Drive in Anytown. She manages the retail floor at Ridgeline Outfitters Corp — one W-2, box 1 wages $61,784.00, box 2 federal withholding $6,415.00.

Her father Gunnar died in late 2024, and his estate — still in administration — kept his small guide-service business running through 2025 with Sasha managing it day to day. The season went badly (two cancelled contracts and an equipment write-off), and the estate's 2025 Schedule K-1 (Form 1041) allocates Sasha a $11,480.00 share of the business loss (box 6, shown as a loss; no other boxes). Sasha's own money at risk in the activity — the cash she has put in, per her Form 6198 worksheet — is $7,235.00; part of the operation is financed by a nonrecourse note she is not personally liable for, so she is NOT at risk for the full loss.
